title: iOS 27 Simulator on x86-64 Linux
summary: Apple's arm64-only iOS 27 Simulator runtime, unmodified, translated to x86-64 on the fly by an embedded JIT (dynarmic) inside Darling. No Mac at runtime. Graphics, input and networking go to native Linux services.
now: Speed 2: Settings GPU cold/warm-relaunch tap-to-content ~30.6 s (translate ~6 s / execute ~24 s; Metal ~0). svc native objc_msgSend opt-in (X86CODE_A64_NATIVE_OBJC=1): correct on objcswift+Settings, slower than guest (~537 vs ~291 ms msgSend) — needs inlined emit. cloudd storm gone. Preferences ~110% idle. Leave-running: GPU home on :0.
metrics: translate ~5.9-6.2 s / ~565K blocks; rest JIT execute; Metal ~0 (home warm)
per-process JIT cache discarded on terminate
svc boundary loses; native path opt-in only
~50 fps; p50 16.7 ms; latency p50 ~23 ms
Metal-to-Vulkan CA; Settings UI on GPU

stages.name: 0. Proof of concept
stages.detail: Small arm64 iOS-simulator programs run on x86-64 Linux under dynarmic. 2.45x slower than native x86 overall; calls into native x86 code cost nothing.

stages.name: 1. Inside Darling
stages.detail: Darling's loader hands arm64 programs to the JIT. Apple's own dyld_sim maps the iOS 27 shared cache; libobjc and libswiftCore run translated. System calls go through native x86 libsystem stubs generated from the cache.

stages.name: 2. Boot to the home screen
stages.detail: launchd_sim → daemons → backboardd → SpringBoard, all arm64 under the JIT, software rendering. Fixed: native malloc, signal delivery, per-thread data, tagged pointers, FP16 instructions, thread cleanup, memory-range exhaustion.

stages.name: 3. Fast and lean
stages.detail: Done: shared cache, slim-park, idle CPU, Metal CA home+Settings, openurl/nsurlsessiond, launch breakdown, svc objc_msgSend experiment (opt-in; inlined next). Next: persistent JIT cache, inlined objc_msgSend, Preferences spin, AOT.

stages.name: 4. Near native
stages.detail: Translate the fixed iOS 27 shared cache to x86 ahead of time, once per iOS version (like Rosetta 2), with the JIT as fallback.

issues: Cold Settings launch ~30 s (80% JIT execute, 20% translate); need persistent cache + inlined objc_msgSend
svc-based native objc_msgSend is a net loss vs guest (CallSVC overhead); default off
Preferences ~110% CPU after open (background); JIT + pthread_mutex churn
Wallpaper (PosterBoard) still out for memory; home is black wallpaper with correct colorful icons
Memory: ~3.56 GB real vs 1 GB goal — anon_host_jit_meta still large across processes
Wallpaper (PosterBoard), widgets (chronod) and Files left out to save memory
